claims.text: ⍉advanced HIV, pulm Sx: PO fluconazole for 6 to 12 mo
claims.quote: Patients with pulmonary symptoms should be treated with oral fluconazole for 6 to 12 months.
claims.locator: Treatment › Patients without advanced HIV infection

claims.text: ⍉advanced HIV, meningitis: induction w IV liposomal amphotericin B + PO flucytosine for 2 to 4 wks (amphotericin B deoxycholate may be used if ⍉lipid form)
claims.quote: Induction with IV liposomal amphotericin B plus oral flucytosine for 2 to 4 weeks (If lipid formulations of amphotericin B are not available, amphotericin B deoxycholate may be used.)
claims.locator: Treatment › Patients without advanced HIV infection

claims.text: then consolidation w PO fluconazole for 8 wks,
claims.quote: Induction should be followed by consolidation therapy with oral fluconazole for 8 weeks
claims.locator: Treatment › Patients without advanced HIV infection

claims.text: then maintenance PO fluconazole for 6 to 12 mo
claims.quote: Then maintenance therapy with oral fluconazole for 6 to 12 months
claims.locator: Treatment › Patients without advanced HIV infection

claims.text: Advanced HIV, mild-mod localized pulm dz (CSF & urine cx (−), ⍉ extrapulm lesions): PO fluconazole for 6 to 12 mo may be used
claims.quote: Patients with mild to moderate symptoms of localized pulmonary involvement (confirmed by normal CSF parameters, negative cultures of CSF and urine, and no evidence of cutaneous, bone, or other extrapulmonary lesions) may be treated with oral fluconazole for 6 to 12 months.
claims.locator: Treatment › Patients with advanced HIV infection

claims.text: Advanced HIV, meningitis or severe pulm dz: induction w IV liposomal amphotericin B Q1x day + PO flucytosine for the first 2 wks
claims.quote: Induction therapy with IV liposomal amphotericin B once a day plus oral flucytosine for the first 2 weeks of treatment
claims.locator: Treatment › Patients with advanced HIV infection

claims.text: If ⍉lipid form: amphotericin B deoxycholate should be used
claims.quote: (If lipid formulations of amphotericin B are not available, amphotericin B deoxycholate should be used.)
claims.locator: Treatment › Patients with advanced HIV infection

claims.text: Alt induction: single ↑dose IV liposomal amphotericin B (day 1) + PO flucytosine and PO fluconazole for the first 2 wks
claims.quote: Alternative induction therapy with single high-dose IV liposomal amphotericin B (on day 1) plus oral flucytosine and oral fluconazole (both oral medications for the first 2 weeks of treatment) (3)
claims.locator: Treatment › Patients with advanced HIV infection

claims.text: then consolidation w PO fluconazole for 8 wks, then long-term maintenance w PO fluconazole
claims.quote: Induction therapy should be followed by consolidation therapy with oral fluconazole for 8 weeks Once induction and consolidation therapy are completed, long-term suppressive (maintenance) therapy is with oral fluconazole
claims.locator: Treatment › Patients with advanced HIV infection

claims.text: Maintenance until CD4 > 100 cells/mcL on ART
claims.quote: Nearly all patients with advanced HIV infection also need maintenance therapy until CD4 cell counts are > 100 cells/mcL on antiretroviral therapy (4).
claims.locator: Treatment › Patients with advanced HIV infection

claims.text: Fluconazole preferred - itraconazole @ same dose = acceptable (measure serum levels to confirm absorb)
claims.quote: Oral fluconazole is preferred, but itraconazole at the same dose is acceptable; however, itraconazole serum levels should be measured to make sure that patients are absorbing the medication.
claims.locator: Treatment › Patients with advanced HIV infection
